attributes.storage_instructions: Store FML eye drops below 25°C in a clean and dry place. Keep it away from children and pets. You should not use the eye drops once the expiry date has passed. Discard it properly. You need to discard the medicine 4 weeks from first opening it. Do not use this medicine if you notice the contents are of a different colour in any way or if particles are present.
